description: Record a tool the user explicitly picked/rejected/tried/starred, or PURCHASED. Call it with action 'purchased' right after the user tells you they bought a paid plan of a listed tool (ask first; never log silently), and again later with action 'feedback' once they have used it for a while (e.g. weekly), passing rating only. Optional fields apply to purchased/feedback only. Stored under your key (key-associated / pseudonymous — the key identifies your feed, not your name); forget_me deletes it. picked/rejected also shape whats_new. purchased/feedback are the durable usage-experience record: they are written ONLY when the key owner has the usage_collection consent scope active (consent_request_receipt -> confirm on the VCP page -> consent_update); without it the call is refused. picked/rejected/tried/starred are feed-shaping signals covered by the explicit feed opt-in (subscribe) and work without usage_collection. Pass a stable event_id (or idempotency_key) to make the call deduped: a replay with the same key returns duplicate:1 and writes nothing. A call with no key is legacy: it always appends, and the response marks it legacy:1/unverified:1. A purchase logged here is self-reported, never a verified order. Prefer record_decision for project-bound usage events.
